metadata.methodology_summary: 補充工具驗證：每題獨立建立合成提醒，避免前一道流程失敗使後續工具完全未測。另行凍結與量測，不併入原始 38 題指標。
metadata.methodology: Serial interleaved cold worker processes; no hidden retries or forced tool calls; native internal fallbacks retained. Each attachment episode has two real LINE events. Timings include both events and captured delivery, not mobile network receipt.
metadata.warmup: None: each measured arm starts a fresh isolated process; provider preparation and native fixture initialization precede the measured episode.
metadata.scope: Synthetic private chats only; no production memory or LINE sends. Real providers, public corpus, memory, reminder store and generated media. Diary summary derivation is a local fixture.
metadata.limitations: 每題每版本一個樣本；不是群組／通知到達率／排程壓力測試。v1 使用原生功能，v2 使用 Hermes tools。AI 盲評不等於人工評價；圖片視覺品質由頁面人工檢查。
metadata.quality_judge: Blinded GPT-6-Sol; six dimensions; architecture and timing withheld. Text/evidence only; no visual image grading.
metadata.corpus: Actual read-only public-corpus HTTP service; D028 intentionally unavailable for every arm.
metadata.image_policy: Real native generation; JPEG original/preview artifacts outside Git; no substitute images.
metadata.supplemental_description: 事後補充的提醒能力探測：原始 38 題的提醒建立階段失敗曾阻擋後續工作流程，因此另外以獨立、新建的合成資料測試既有提醒的列出／修改／取消。這三題不是原始測試成功的替代品；必須另行凍結、執行與報告，不改寫原始結果。

publication.source_bodies: omitted for public_search, corpus_search and read_link; source title/URL/ID/provenance retained
publication.measured_answers: preserved verbatim; unsafe answers require explicit review
publication.synthetic_evidence: authored memory, attachment fixtures and validation preserved
publication.assets: URLs only; no image bytes or local media paths
publication.note: 公開副本省略第三方來源原文、本機路徑與憑證；原始量測檔案保留於本機。
